Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NABFINS CSO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 12th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the CSO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed PUC or 10+2. Fresher candidates are also eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for further information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely through email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the specified email addresses.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Customer Service Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Customer Service Officer (CSO) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the CSO role?
faq.answer: The salary details are not provided in the extracted information. Please refer to the official notification for salary information.

faq.question: Q7. Can freshers apply for the CSO position?
faq.answer: Yes, freshers are eligible to apply for the Customer Service Officer (CSO) post, provided they meet the minimum educational qualification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job is located in Ganjam, Odisha. This role is for field staff, as indicated in the brief description.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is Nabhins/OPS/1069.
